searchText: It's my understanding that the initial choice of issuance curve was driven by considerations around epsilon discouragement attacks. After looking at this myself, it appears that EIP-8363 changes profitability constraints of them in a major way for realistic scenarios due to the changed yield-elasticity. So I'm kind of wondering if I'm missing something or why this isn't part of the discussion at all and not even mentioned in Security Considerations.

excerpts.content:
It's my understanding that the initial choice of issuance curve was driven by considerations around epsilon discouragement attacks. After looking at this myself, it appears that EIP-8363 changes profitability constraints of them in a major way for realistic scenarios due to the changed yield-elasticity. 

So I'm kind of wondering if I'm missing something or why this isn't part of the discussion at all and not even mentioned in Security Considerations.
